LHHOTEL – Thailand Tourism Outlook
Influx of International Visitors and Recovery of Thai  Tourism and Hospitality Industry 
[Source] Tourism Authority of Thailand.
•For the full year 2025, total tourist arrivals to Thailand reached 33.0 million representing a 
decline of approximately 7.2% yoy.
•International air traffic continued its strong recovery, reaching 535,892 flights, an increase of 
23% yoyand 7% above pre -pandemic levels in 2019.
•According to the Top 100 City Destinations Index 2025 by Euromonitor International, Bangkok 
was ranked as the world’s most visited city for the second consecutive year since 2024, 
followed by Hong Kong and London.
•In 2026, the government has focused on attracting high -potential long -haul travelers with higher 
average spending, while strengthening confidence in Thailand’s safety. Key measures include 
visa facilitation, enhanced air connectivity, and proactive marketing in European and Middle
